editorContract.inlineRangeEvidence: findings/evidence/f078-inline-format-on-a-selection/ -- all four inline formats measured on both range shapes against the shipped artifact f923cfa5, the formatted text equal to the selected text in every arm, with a baseline save and a shipped-profile control. Both bits are granted because the engine's gate requires both for an unclassified range; granting one alone admits nothing, measured. A fully selected paragraph comes back as paragraph-level formatting, which native LibreOffice 26.8 does identically (same extent, same shape, measured with tools/f078_native_range_format.cpp). Chrome only, one fixture, one selection geometry per arm; the 5-character list prefix the copy path reports on a cross-paragraph selection is unexplained and touches no formatting outcome

verdict.note: If the ODT control did not open, NOTHING here is about Calc: the instrument is the first suspect and the spreadsheet rows must not be read.
